Neural Representations of Popularity and Leadership Status: RSA

Ovidia Stanoi

1/30/2026

This script includes 3 regression models that estimate, at the dyad level, how similarly two individuals are represented in the 9 ROIs of interest (valuation: vmPFC, amygdala, striatum, social cognition: dmPFC, rTPJ, lTPJ, relational binding: rHPC, lHPC, EC) as a function of how different their popularity and leadership statuses are. The first regression model (model 1) includes an interaction term between the popularity and leadership status differences to explore how the relationship between the difference in leadership status and neural dissimilarity in different ROIs might be moderated by difference in popularity status and vice-versa. The next two models include only the main effects of popularity status differences (model 2) or leadership status differences (model 3). Comparing these models allows us to explore what ROIs represent popularity and leadership status information in an interdependent manner or independently. To account for multiple comparisons, all models are run in a multilevel framework with random slopes per ROI, nested within brain systems. We also included random intercepts for perceiver, social targets, and dyads, nested within groups. No control variables were included.

Clear global environment.

remove(list=ls())

Open packages.

library("tidyverse")
library("corrplot")
library("reshape")
library("rstanarm")
library("bmlm")
library("bayestestR")
library("flextable")
library("officer")
library("brms")
library("tidybayes")
library("posterior")

Set up ggplot theme.

theme_set(theme_bw() +

Set up the file directory.

path <- "~/Dropbox/Psychology_Projects/MURI Faces 2D"

Read the RSA dataset.

d1 <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/Data/rsa_dataset.csv", path))
d2 <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/Data/rsa_dataset_individual_ratings.csv", path)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(like_diff_indepent_ratings_cw = like_diff_cw, 
        leader_diff_indepent_ratings_cw = leader_diff_cw) %>%
  select(groupID, pID, dyad_name, roi, like_diff_indepent_ratings_cw, leader_diff_indepent_ratings_cw)
d <- left_join(d1, d2, by = c("groupID", "pID", "dyad_name", "roi"))
d$brain_system <- ifelse(d$roi %in% c("HO_amygdala", "Kable_VS", "vmPFC"), "valuation",
                         ifelse(d$roi %in% c("ERC", "r_HPC", "l_HPC"), "relational_binding",
                                ifelse(d$roi %in% c("Saxe_dmPFC", "l_TPJ", "r_TPJ"), "social_cognition", NA)))

Check the data format.

head(d)

Obtain ROI-level varying betas for the popularity status difference and leadership status difference interaction effect.

# Load model results
load(sprintf("%s/Model Results/RSA_Model1.RData", path))

# Extract posterior draws
roi_draws <- m %>%
  spread_draws(b_Intercept, b_like_diff_cw, b_leader_diff_cw,
               `b_like_diff_cw:leader_diff_cw`,
               `r_brain_system:roi`[roi, term]) %>%
  mutate(beta = case_when(
    term == "Intercept" ~ b_Intercept + `r_brain_system:roi`,
    term == "like_diff_cw" ~ b_like_diff_cw + `r_brain_system:roi`,
    term == "leader_diff_cw" ~ b_leader_diff_cw + `r_brain_system:roi`,
    term == "like_diff_cw:leader_diff_cw" ~ `b_like_diff_cw:leader_diff_cw` + `r_brain_system:roi`)) %>%
  mutate(roi = dplyr::recode(roi, 
                             "social_cognition_Saxe_dmPFC" = "dmPFC",
                             "valuation_HO_amygdala" = "Amygdala",
                             "relational_binding_r_HPC" = "rHPC",       
                             "social_cognition_r_TPJ" = "rTPJ",       
                             "valuation_Kable_VS" = "VS",
                             "relational_binding_ERC" = "ERC",
                             "relational_binding_l_HPC" = "lHPC",
                             "social_cognition_l_TPJ" = "lTPJ", 
                             "valuation_vmPFC" = "vmPFC"),
         roi = factor(roi, levels = c("vmPFC", "Amygdala", "VS", 
                                          "dmPFC", "rTPJ", "lTPJ",
                                          "rHPC", "lHPC", "ERC")),
         roi_type = ifelse(roi %in% c("vmPFC", "Amygdala", "VS"), "valuation",
                        ifelse(roi %in% c("dmPFC", "rTPJ", "lTPJ"), "social_cognition",
                               "relational_binding"))) %>%
  select(.draw, roi, roi_type, term, beta) 

# Summarize estimates per ROI
b_df <- roi_draws %>%
  group_by(roi, roi_type, term) %>%
  summarise(beta_int = median(beta),
            sd = sd(beta),
            low_ci = quantile(beta, 0.025),
            upp_ci = quantile(beta, 0.975)) 

# Save beta sumamries in a .csv file 
write.csv(b_df, (sprintf("%s/Data/RSA_Model1_Betas.csv", path)),
          row.names = F)

# Plot dyad-level betas' posterior mean and 95% credible interval
ggplot(data = b_df[b_df$term=="like_diff_cw:leader_diff_cw",], 
       aes(x = roi, 
           y = beta_int)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, 
             linewidth = 1.2, linetype = 2) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = low_ci,
                      ymax = upp_ci, color = roi_type),
                  size = 1.2, linewidth = .9) +  # use for .html figure
  # geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = low_ci, 
  #                      ymax = upp_ci, color = roi_type), 
  #                  size = 3, linewidth = 3) + # use for .tiff figure
  scale_color_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "dodgerblue4", "darkgreen")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(add = c(0.006, 0.002))) +
  labs(x = "ROI", y = "Interaction Effect & 95% CIs") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

# ggsave(file = sprintf("%s/Figures/Figure2A_RSA_Model1_Interaction_Betas.tiff", path),
#        plot = last_plot(), width=15, height=6, units = "in", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

Check results.

# Extract interaction posterior distribution
df_int <- b_df %>%

  ungroup() %>%   #
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         CI_95 = paste0("[", low_ci, ", ", upp_ci, "]")) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("low_ci", "upp_ci", "roi_type", "term"))) %>%
  arrange(roi)

# Create table of results  
b_df_table <- flextable(df_int) %>%
  set_header_labels(roi = "ROI",
    beta_int = "Beta Estimate",
    sd = "SE",

  autofit() %>%

# Save to Word document
doc <- read_docx() %>%

  body_add_flextable(b_df_table)

print(doc, target = sprintf("%s/Tables/TableS5_RSA_Model1_Interaction_Betas.docx", path))

What percentage of the distribution is higher than zero for the vmPFC and rTPJ interaction effects?

# Extract only the interaction posterior distributions.
roi_draws_int <- roi_draws %>%
    filter(term == "like_diff_cw:leader_diff_cw")

# vmPFC
round(length(which(roi_draws_int$beta[roi_draws_int$roi == "vmPFC"]>0))/4000*100,1)
## [1] 99.9
# r TPJ
round(length(which(roi_draws_int$beta[roi_draws_int$roi == "rTPJ"]>0))/4000*100,1)
## [1] 99.1

Plot the vmPFC interaction effect. To understand what the interaction effect means, check how the relationship between difference in leadership status and neural dissimilarity in the vmPFC is moderated by difference in popularity status.

# Extract all vmPFC-specific  posterior distributions 
p <- roi_draws %>%
  filter(roi == "vmPFC")  %>%
  select(.draw, term, beta) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = beta)  %>%
  dplyr::rename(draw =.draw, 
                intercept = Intercept, 
                b_like_diff = like_diff_cw, 
                b_leader_diff = leader_diff_cw,
                b_like_leader_int = `like_diff_cw:leader_diff_cw`)

# Calculate summary values
p <- p %>%
  dplyr::mutate(m_int = median(intercept),
         m_b_like_diff = median(b_like_diff), 
         m_b_leader_diff = median(b_leader_diff),
         m_b_like_leader_int = median(b_like_leader_int))

# Sample 4000 random draws (decrease the number if fewer random draws wanted)
nr_random_draws <- 4000 

# Calculate  +/-1.5SD*(Popularity Difference)
lw_1.5sd <- round(-1.5*sd(d$like_diff_cw, na.rm = T), 3)
up_1.5sd <- round(1.5*sd(d$like_diff_cw, na.rm = T), 3)

# Create a dataframe that includes predicted y values for like_diff = lw_1.5sd for the random draws
p_lw <- p[rep(seq_len(nrow(p)), each = 7), ] %>%
  mutate(seq = rep(-2:4, nr_random_draws),
         like_diff = lw_1.5sd,
         like_diff_label = "Small Difference in Popularity Status") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_draw = intercept + b_like_diff * like_diff + b_leader_diff * seq +
           b_like_leader_int * like_diff * seq,
         y_fe = m_int + m_b_like_diff * like_diff + m_b_leader_diff * seq +
           m_b_like_leader_int * like_diff * seq)

# Create a dataframe that includes predicted y values for like_diff = up_1.5sd for the random draws
p_up <- p[rep(seq_len(nrow(p)), each = 7), ] %>%
  mutate(seq = rep(-2:4, nr_random_draws),
         like_diff = up_1.5sd,
         like_diff_label = "Large Difference in Popularity Status") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_draw = intercept + b_like_diff * like_diff + b_leader_diff * seq +
           b_like_leader_int * like_diff * seq,
         y_fe = m_int + m_b_like_diff * like_diff + m_b_leader_diff * seq +
           m_b_like_leader_int * like_diff * seq)

# Merge files
p_all <- rbind(p_lw, p_up) 

# Make the grouping variable a factor
p_all$like_diff_label <- factor(p_all$like_diff_label, 
                                  levels = c("Small Difference in Popularity Status",
                                          "Large Difference in Popularity Status"))

# Plot results - separate plots for +/-1.5SD*(Popularity Difference)
ggplot(p_all, aes(x = seq, y_draw, group = draw)) +
  facet_wrap(~like_diff_label) +
  labs(y = "Neural Dissimilarity in vmPFC", 
       x = "Difference in Leadership Status") +
  geom_line(aes(color = like_diff_label), alpha = .1, size = .1) +
  geom_line(aes(seq, y_fe), color = "black", size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(" forestgreen", "darkgreen"))

# ggsave(file = sprintf("%s/Figures/Figure2B_RSA_Model1_Interaction_vmPFC.tiff", path),
#        plot = last_plot(), width=10, height=6, units = "in", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")

Check whether the 95% CI of the slope representing the relationship between leadership status difference and neural dissimilarity in the vmPFC includes zero for dyads that are relatively more similar (+1.5 SD) or relatively less similar (-1.5 SD) in their popularity status.

# Calculate individual slopes representing the relationship between 
# leadership status difference and neural dissimilarity 
# for each draw of the posterior distribution when like_diff = lw_1.5sd
p$b_leader_diff_lw <- (p$b_leader_diff + p$b_like_leader_int * lw_1.5sd)

# Extract the mean and 95% credible interval
b_leader_diff_lw <- round(quantile(p$b_leader_diff_lw, probs = c(0.025, .5, 0.975)),3)
b_leader_diff_lw
##   2.5%    50%  97.5% 
## -0.016 -0.009 -0.002
round(length(which(p$b_leader_diff_lw<0))/4000*100,1)
## [1] 99.7
# Calculate individual slopes representing the relationship between 
# leadership status difference and neural dissimilarity 
# for each draw of the posterior distribution when like_diff = up_1.5sd
p$b_leader_diff_up <- (p$b_leader_diff + p$b_like_leader_int * up_1.5sd)

# Extract the mean and 95% credible interval
b_leader_diff_up <- round(quantile(p$b_leader_diff_up, probs = c(0.025, .5, 0.975)),3)
b_leader_diff_up
##  2.5%   50% 97.5% 
## 0.003 0.009 0.016
round(length(which(p$b_leader_diff_up>0))/4000*100,1)
## [1] 99.9

Obtain ROI-level varying betas for the popularity status difference main effect.

# Save posterior draws of ROI-specific popularity status slope
roi_draws_like <- roi_draws %>%
  filter(term == "like_diff_cw")

# Summarize estimates per ROI
b_df <- roi_draws_like %>%
  group_by(roi, roi_type) %>%
  summarise(beta_like = median(beta),
            sd = sd(beta),
            low_ci = quantile(beta, 0.025),
            upp_ci = quantile(beta, 0.975)) 

# Plot dyad-level betas' posterior mean and 95% credible interval
ggplot(data = b_df, 
       aes(x = roi, 
           y = beta_like)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, 
             linewidth = 0.9, linetype = 2) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = low_ci, 
                      ymax = upp_ci, color = roi_type), 
                  size = 1.2, linewidth = .9) + 
  labs(x = "ROI", y = "ROI-Level Betas & 95% CIs",
       title = "Popularity Status Difference Effect on ROI Neural Dissimilarity") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "dodgerblue4", "darkgreen")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

Check results.

  select(-c(low_ci, upp_ci, roi_type)) %>%
  arrange(roi)

# Create table of results

  set_header_labels(roi = "ROI",
    beta_like = "Beta Estimate",
    sd = "SE",
    CI_95 = "95% CI") %>%
  autofit() %>%

2 Model 2 (Popularity Status Main Effect)

Run multilevel regression model 2: Neural Dissimilarity ~ Popularity Status Differences

# options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
# m2 <- brm(neural_dissimilarity ~ like_diff_cw + 
#            (1 | groupID:pID) +
#            (1 | groupID:dyad_name) +
#            (1 | mm(face_1, face_2)) +
#            (like_diff_cw | brain_system:roi),
#          data = d,
#          control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
#          seed = 123)
# save(m2, file = sprintf("%s/Model Results/RSA_Model2.RData", path))

Obtain ROI-level varying betas for the popularity status difference main effect.

# Load model results
load(sprintf("%s/Model Results/RSA_Model2.RData", path))

# Extract posterior draws
roi_draws <- m2 %>%
  spread_draws(b_like_diff_cw,
               `r_brain_system:roi`[roi, term]) %>%
  filter(term == "like_diff_cw") %>%
  mutate(beta = b_like_diff_cw + `r_brain_system:roi`) %>%
  mutate(roi = dplyr::recode(roi, 
                             "social_cognition_Saxe_dmPFC" = "dmPFC",
                             "valuation_HO_amygdala" = "Amygdala",
                             "relational_binding_r_HPC" = "rHPC",       
                             "social_cognition_r_TPJ" = "rTPJ",       
                             "valuation_Kable_VS" = "VS",
                             "relational_binding_ERC" = "ERC",
                             "relational_binding_l_HPC" = "lHPC",
                             "social_cognition_l_TPJ" = "lTPJ", 
                             "valuation_vmPFC" = "vmPFC"),
         roi = factor(roi, levels = c("vmPFC", "Amygdala", "VS", 
                                          "dmPFC", "rTPJ", "lTPJ",
                                          "rHPC", "lHPC", "ERC")),
         roi_type = ifelse(roi %in% c("vmPFC", "Amygdala", "VS"), "valuation",
                        ifelse(roi %in% c("dmPFC", "rTPJ", "lTPJ"), "social_cognition",
                               "relational_binding"))) %>%
  select(.draw, roi, roi_type, beta) 

# Summarize estimates per ROI
b_df <- roi_draws %>%
  group_by(roi, roi_type, term) %>%
  summarise(beta_like = median(beta),
            sd = sd(beta),
            low_ci = quantile(beta, 0.025),
            upp_ci = quantile(beta, 0.975)) 

# Plot dyad-level betas' posterior mean and 95% credible interval
ggplot(data = b_df, 
       aes(x = roi, 
           y = beta_like)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, 
             linewidth = 0.9, linetype = 2) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = low_ci, 
                      ymax = upp_ci, color = roi_type), 
                  size = 1.2, linewidth = .9) + 
  labs(x = "ROI", y = "ROI-Level Betas & 95% CIs",
       title = "Popularity Status Difference Effect on ROI Neural Dissimilarity") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("goldenrod2", "dodgerblue4", "darkgreen")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1))

Check results.

# Arrange data
b_df_table <- b_df %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         CI_95 = paste0("[", round(low_ci, 3), ", ", round(upp_ci, 3), "]")) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("low_ci", "upp_ci", "roi_type", "term"))) %>%
  arrange(roi)

# Create table of results  
b_df_table <- flextable(b_df_table) %>%
  set_header_labels(roi = "ROI",
    beta_like = "Beta Estimate",
    sd = "SE",
    CI_95 = "95% CI") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_booktabs()

# Save to Word document
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Table: RSA Results: Popularity Status Difference Main Effect", 
               style = "heading 2") %>%
  body_add_flextable(b_df_table)

print(doc, target = sprintf("%s/Tables/TableS2_RSA_Model2_Popularity_Betas.docx", path))
